purpose: Test the distinct hypothesis that the low-capacity HGB state/context model is useful only as a small complementary component of the honest M3 identity anchor.
relationship_to_failed_ablation: V5_HGB_STATE_CONTEXT_V1 is rejected as a standalone candidate and remains prohibited from direct 2024 confirmation. This is a separately locked two-component recipe whose coefficient is selected on an earlier source fold and transferred unchanged.

data_rules.history_rule: season strictly before every scored year

source_selection.hgb_recipe: exact fixed candidate recipe and params from V5_HGB_STATE_CONTEXT_V1
source_selection.anchor: honest M3 R identity for 2021, with its three nonnegative component weights fitted on 2020 R only
source_selection.selection: minimum 2021 R Brier; exact ties choose the smaller HGB weight

development_gate.uncertainty: pitcher-cluster bootstrap 95% interval with 1000 fixed-seed replicates
requirements: source-selected HGB weight is greater than zero
positive R point gain over the exact honest-identity parent in both 2022 and 2023
positive R 95% gain lower bound over the exact honest-identity parent in both 2022 and 2023
positive R point gain over honest-grid and exact C in both 2022 and 2023
development_gate.on_fail: reject the complementary blend without running 2024
development_gate.on_pass: freeze the source-selected coefficient and run 2024 exactly once
